# Repository Guidelines

## Agent bootstrap

Before changing files, read `.ai/architecture.yaml`, `.ai/rules/common.md`, `.ai/service.yaml`, `.ai/commands.yaml`, `docs/README.md`, the relevant workflow, and affected contracts. Capture `git status --short` and `git diff`, then run `./scripts/check-agent-policy.sh`; stop fail-closed if it fails. Code, migrations, tests, and repository-owned documents are authoritative.

## Architecture invariants

- `internal/domain` owns planning types and ports; `internal/usecase` owns deterministic gap analysis, ordering, fingerprinting, job orchestration, and policy application.
- The service decides what a student should learn and in which order. It never owns Course content, student mastery/progress, or runtime Teacher actions.
- `ms-go-course` owns every created Course and its hierarchy. Planner creates or reuses a Course through a typed private contract; it does not add a hierarchy layer between Course and Module.
- `ms-go-student` owns onboarding, mastery, evidence, Course assignments, and progress. Self-assessment is a hypothesis and never sufficient evidence for skipping a target.
- Course planning is deterministic before model enrichment. Unknown targets are included; only objective policy-qualified mastery may skip a target.
- Course fingerprints are versioned canonical identities. They never include student IDs, timestamps, raw evidence, or unstable array order.
- Critical Course creation and Student assignment use synchronous idempotent HTTP commands. Messaging is not a commit boundary.
- Prompt/model providers remain behind approved outbound ports. Generated structure is untrusted and cannot invent target identities.
- Transport is inbound-only. Direct children of `internal/transport` are limited to `http`, `message`, `cli`, `websocket`, and `common`; direct children of `internal/transport/http` are limited to `api`, `admin`, and `private`.
- Public, admin, and private handlers belong only to their contour. Mixed inbound/outbound layer directories are forbidden.
- `internal/infrastructure` is outbound-only and fail-closed to `persistence/postgres` and `http/student`, `http/course`, and future explicitly approved clients.
- Domain and use cases must not import transport, infrastructure, chi, pgx, provider SDKs, or concrete HTTP clients. Composition belongs in `cmd/ms-go-learning-planner/main.go`.

## Verification and delivery

- Use `.ai/commands.yaml`. After edits, rerun `./scripts/check-agent-policy.sh` and every scope-relevant declared command.
- HTTP, database, fingerprint, policy, target-graph, or cross-service changes require synchronized tests and contracts.
- Migrations, provider calls, services, deployment, push, and destructive commands require the approval declared in `.ai/commands.yaml`.
